title: Director of Data Engineering
jobDescription: The Onyx Research Data Platform organization represents a major investment by GSK R&D and Digital & Tech, designed to deliver a step change in our ability to leverage data, knowledge, and prediction to find new medicines. We are a full-stack shop consisting of product and portfolio leadership, data engineering, infrastructure and DevOps, data / metadata / knowledge platforms, and AI/ML and analysis platforms, all geared toward. Building a next-generation data experience for GSK’s scientists, engineers, and decision-makers, increasing productivity, and reducing time spent on “data mechanics”. Providing best-in-class AI/ML and data analysis environments to accelerate our predictive capabilities and attract top-tier talent. Aggressively engineering our data at scale to unlock the value of our combined data assets and predictions in real-time. Director of Data Engineering is responsible for the design, delivery, support, and maintenance of industrialised automated end to end data services and pipelines. They apply standardised data models and mapping to ensure data is accessible for end users in end-to-end user tools through use of APIs. They define and embed best practices and ensure compliance with Quality Management practices and alignment to automated data governance. They also acquire and process internal and external, structure and unstructured data in line with Product requirements. As a Director of Data Engineering, you are responsible for building and leading a scrum team of world-class data engineers focused on building automated, scalable, and sustainable pipelines to account for evolving scientific needs. You deeply influence the engineering direction of the Onyx platform, ensuring we built the best-in-class capabilities across data ingestion, streaming, transformation, knowledge, metadata, vectorized data pipelines and AI/GenAI integration. You support the head of Data Engineering in building a strong culture of accountability and ownership in you team, as well as instilling strong engineering practices (e.g., testing, code reviews, DevOps-forward ways of working). You work in close partnership with our Platforms teams to ensure we have the right tools and ways of working, and with our Bioinformatics teams to ensure the use of appropriate schemas, vocabularies, and ontologies. This role is for an engineer who combines hands-on expertise with strategic vision, operating oth as a senior builder, architect and technical thought leader. Key Responsibilities. Lead and mentor a team of data engineers in delivering data and knowledge products that advance GSK R&D. Architect and define the long-term data delivery and operational data engineering strategy in a complex and ambiguous data and knowledge ecosystem. Partner closely with other Data Engineering leads to drive standars for observability, scalability, performance optimization and operational excellence . Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex platform and pipeline issues and represent engineering in forums related to standards, compliance, technical strategy and cross R&D data initiatives. Collaborate with ML and GenAI teams to optimize and build data flows for fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and champion data best practices for GenAI workfloads. Able to design innovative strategy beyond the current enterprise way of working to create a better environment for the end users, and able to construct a coordinated, stepwise plan to bring others along with the change curve. Standard bearer for proper ways of working and engineering discipline, including the QMS framework and CI/CD best practices and proactively spearhead improvement within their engineering area. Exemplar leaders in their field of technical knowledge, keen on bettering their understanding and acting as the knowledge holder for the organisation . Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required. 20+ Years of Experience. Strong data engineering experience in industry. Software engineering experience. Demonstratable experience overcoming high volume, high compute challenges. Familiarity with orchestrating tooling. Cloud experience. Experience in automated testing and design. Experience with DevOps-forward ways of working. Job Related Experience sections above that are required for the job. Deep knowledge and use of at least one common programming language: e.g., Python, Scala, Java. Deep experience with common big data tools (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Storm, …). Cloud experience (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Kubernetes). Application experience of CI/CD implementations using git and a common CI/CD stack (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab, Azure DevOps). Experience with agile software development environments using tools like Jira and Confluence . Experience with Infrastructure as a Code and automation tools (i.e. Terraform). Expertise in data modelling, database concepts and SQL. Nice to have familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, LLM data pipelines and RAG architecture. Skills. Algorithms, Data Assessment, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Feature Engineering, Hypothesis Testing, Mathematics Modeling, Predictive Modeling, Probabilistic Modeling, Statistical Analysis, Statistical Analysis Techniques. jobDescription: At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. title: Senior Principal - Development & CMO Digital & Tech Strategy
jobDescription: GSK Development and Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Digital and Technology’s mission is to disrupt and transform the way GSK thinks about, generates and submits evidence to radically accelerate the delivery of medicines and vaccines for our patients and participants. We act as a strategic thought partner for the Development Operations and CMO organisations, bringing together diverse stakeholders to radically transform and connect siloed processes using innovative and integrated technology. Your role. As the Senior Principal, Strategy you will be a pivotal partner for the Development and CMO Digital and Technology leadership team, responsible for both shaping our strategic agenda and driving its execution to help us radically accelerate the delivery of medicines and vaccines. You will probe and clarify strategic choices, lead analysis on critical business problems, and own high-priority initiatives from concept to completion. Alongside this, you will serve as a chief of staff to the leadership team - acting as the throughline across our planning cycles, governance, and leadership sessions to ensure strategy translates into decisive action. You will work closely with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio team, ensuring their capabilities and processes are leveraged in service of our objectives. This role requires you to move seamlessly between high-level strategic thinking and the hands-on work of keeping a complex leadership team focused, aligned, and moving forward. Your responsibilities. Drive and Facilitate the Leadership Team's Strategic Agenda: Act as the throughline for the leadership team's strategic agenda - ensuring what gets discussed becomes decided, and what gets decided gets done. You will own the meeting rhythm: setting agendas, ensuring pre-reads are in place, and working with teams across the department to drive actions to completion between sessions. Lead High-Priority & Cross-Cutting Strategic Initiatives: Take direct ownership of ambiguous, high-impact projects, particularly those that cut across multiple programmes and teams. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle: shaping the hypothesis, conducting analysis, building consensus, and delivering integrated solutions that drive our transformation forward. Co-lead Annual Planning: In partnership with the Strategy Director, co-lead the annual planning cycle - driving both the OKR-setting process and the investment planning process, ensuring the two are aligned and that clear trade-off decisions are made. Build and Communicate a Shared Strategic Narrative: Own the communications that bring our strategy to life across the department - translating leadership decisions and strategic priorities into clear, compelling messages for all staff, so that everyone understands where we are going and how their work connects to it. Partner with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio Team: Work closely with the Portfolio team to ensure the operational processes that underpin both our strategic programmes and the day-to-day running of the department are effective and efficient — identifying where things aren't working and driving improvements that help the department deliver against its objectives. Why you? Basic Qualifications. Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a scientific area (e.g. computer science, engineering, mathematics), or related quantitative discipline. 15+ Experience in technology strategy, within a large-scale technology organisation, a corporate strategy function, or a management consulting firm. Experience supporting or operating as chief of staff to a senior leadership team, including owning meeting rhythms, governance forums, and cross-team action tracking. Relevant experience in the life sciences industry. We are looking for professionals with the following capabilities. Senior Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to act as a trusted partner to leaders, building strong relationships, providing candid advice, and facilitating high-stakes discussions to drive alignment and clear decisions. Structured Problem-Solving and Analysis: A highly analytical mindset with the ability to take ambiguous, complex business problems, structure them, and drive them to a concrete solution through hands-on analysis and project management. Exceptional Communication and Synthesis: The ability to synthesise complex information into clear, concise narratives for a range of audiences, from executive leadership to all staff. You can distil the "so what" and make strategy feel relevant and actionable at every level. Preferred Qualifications. R&D Domain Knowledge: Understanding of the pharmaceutical R&D value chain, from drug discovery and clinical development through to regulatory submission. Agile Ways of Working: Familiarity with Agile principles and ways of working (e.g. Scrum, SAFe), with the ability to operate effectively within an organisation that runs on agile rhythms.
